description: Sanford, FL – Despite repeated invitations and follow-ups from local news station WESH 2, former TV anchor Ryan Elijah has refused to commit to a debate with Navy combat veteran and Democratic nominee Bale Dalton.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Dalton for Florida Bale Dalton is a former member of the United States Navy and current member of the United States Navy Reserve
title: Former TV Anchor Ryan Elijah Gets Stage Fright: Dodges Debates and Won’t Answer to Voters - Bale Dalton
